outer: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square seamless tileable RGBA game texture for a stationary alien cobweb membrane in Freelancer's Nomad Lair. Orthographic flat texture only, filling the entire tile edge to edge. An irregular connected network of strong silky cobweb strands intertwined with branching organic tendrils, smaller sparse threads stretched between the thicker branching strands. High contrast, crisply readable thick strands, fine thread detail, many clearly open irregular holes, approximately 60 percent genuinely transparent empty area. A web overgrown with sinewy alien roots, not a conventional radial spiderweb. Restrained pale gray bone and cool muted violet-blue fibres, darker purplish root cores, small bright silk highlights. Diffuse soft even illumination without directional shadows or bloom. The network crosses all four edges and seamlessly continues at opposite edges under WRAP repetition. No border, no vignette, no central emblem, no background surface, no translucent film filling holes, no painted checkerboard, no text. Actual transparency in all holes, near-opaque dense strands, antialiased alpha edges. Production texture, not a scene or material ball.
inner: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square seamless tileable RGBA game texture for an alien overgrown cobweb membrane, Nomad Lair interior in Freelancer. Flat orthographic material texture, filling all edges, not a scene. Dense branching tangled rootlets and sinewy creeping tendrils threaded together with silvery cobweb silk; irregular organic overgrowth, stronger twisting roots surrounded by fine taut web filaments. Strong contrast and legible detail: dark muted plum-brown root cores, desaturated warm bone/tan ridges and pale silk edges, subtle olive undertones. Empty spaces between the roots must be ACTUALLY TRANSPARENT with no background or membrane film; approximately half the texture is open irregular holes. Roots and silk themselves near opaque with crisp antialiased edges. Distribute the growth over the whole tile, no central object or radial spiderweb, no leaves or flowers. Subtle diffuse even illumination; no baked hard shadows, glow or black background. Must tile seamlessly under ordinary WRAP in both axes: strands cross all four edges and continue at their opposite edges. No border, vignette, frame, margin, text, watermark, painted checkerboard, material ball, or perspective.
